name: ovos-rust-messagebus
description: OVOS Message Bus implementation in Rust
author: OscillateLabsLLC

setup_notes.heading: Configuration
setup_notes.content:
Since there is no Rust port of ovos-utils, configuration is done via environment variables and/or a configuration file.

### Using a Configuration File

The most backwards-compatible option is to set the `OVOS_BUS_CONFIG_FILE` environment variable:

OVOS_BUS_CONFIG_FILE=/home/ovos/.config/mycroft/mycroft.conf /usr/local/bin/ovos_messagebus

setup_notes.heading: Additional Configuration
setup_notes.content: Any other settings must be configured in `mycroft.conf` or a similar OVOS-compatible configuration file.
